interest: Shows 1930s protocol limits on imperial audiences for US officials, and State's policy of refusing private audience requests.
overview: Docket (1934-37) on audience requests with Japan's Emperor: official missions like VP Garner's and Pres. Quezon's, plus private requests State declined to sponsor, referring them to Tokyo instead.
